Java 27 Delivers Steady Gains: From Ancient JDK 8 to Today’s Faster, Tighter Runtime

Java 27 makes G1 and compact object headers the default, delivering measurable memory and CPU savings. Long-term benchmarks from JDK 8 to 27 show steady performance gains, while new cryptography accelerations prepare for post-quantum threats. Production adopters already see the benefits.
